title: IDKMesh Readiness Document v0.1
description: The minimal `GET /readyz` readiness document built by `idkmesh/service_runtime.py:readiness_document()` and shared by every IDKMesh HTTP service (currently the Control Tower Local API). It carries no project/evidence state and no secrets -- readiness answers only whether the process is ready for its declared profile (docs/specifications/API_CONVENTIONS_V0_1.md section 16).

api_version.description: Present only when the caller's service has a versioned HTTP API; omitted otherwise.
